key_results: QFORM-WITT-GAP-FORCES-U-RESIDUAL-v1: for an orthonormal residual frame u,v,w and any two-bank cut, shared-shear regression residual energy is at least the v-w bank-gap currency G.
Combining the fresh account03/B05 r40 cross-star decomposition with the max-cut gives max{(1-s)d_J, s d_K, ||p_J||^2+||p_K||^2}>=1/6 in the actual live frame.

The r40 fully bank-collinear shared-shear hypothesis is incompatible with a nonzero regression gap in the exact orthonormal Witt survivor; its theorem remains valid but that nonzero-gap subcase is empty in the live packet.

QFORM-WITT-SOURCE-DISJOINT-SHEAR-v1: for genuinely independent cap-one H,U,V,W, ||p_Q||_inf,ess<=4*sqrt(2)*|a*delta|^-1/2 uniformly in kappa, by the fresh zero-diagonal-edge half-Riesz theorem plus the pinned e5f square peel.
For Q_kappa=2V(H+kappa U)+W^2, spectrum={1,+sqrt(1+kappa^2),-sqrt(1+kappa^2),0}; independent scalar inputs give ||p||_inf<=4*sqrt(2).

QFORM-WITT-JOINT-CAP-CANCELLATION-OBSTRUCTION-v1: a residual joint density <=1 with every coordinate/pair marginal <=1 can nevertheless cancel W^2 and produce p_Q(q)>=(3/4)log(1/(4|q|)); this is not a QFORM counterexample because residual variables are not a scalar product law.
next_attack: Exploit the original product laws inside the max-cut banks to convert the forced residual alternative into a Borel/interval receiver uniform as kappa tends to zero. Joint-density caps alone are now explicitly ruled out; complete source separation is already paid.
